Name: Sam After Dark - A Yandere Dialogue and Event Expansion Pack
Author: loshionbottle
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/xKJhVHX6/overview-better.png[/img][/url]
[color=#e06666][b][size=4][i]WARNING: THERE ARE A FEW EVENTS (THE NEW BATHHOUSE, CHAPEL, AND REWRITTEN VANILLA 10 HEART) WHICH COULD POTENTIALLY TRIGGER USERS WITH EPILEPSY[/i][/size][/b][/color]
The main concern stemming from these events is the lights turn off abruptly & might flicker once or twice.

Anyways, this mod adds around 700+ lines of dialogue for Sam, plus overhauls all of his vanilla events while adding in 13 new events (on top of the existing vanilla) turning him yandere!
This is a smut-free pack!

[i][color=#e06666][b][size=4]POTENTIAL TRIGGER WARNINGS[/size][/b][/color]
[/i]There are no more smut events in this pack! However, this is supposed to be creepy & you may or may not like what's offered here. Please view the following at your own distretion.

[u][b]OVERALL
[/b][/u]The figure's NPC is used in a few events. Its presence is supposed to be unsettling. 

[u][b]SPECIFICALLY[/b][/u][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS] The 1 Heart event is an implied wet dream. Your (dream version) side and thighs and back are touched.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]In the 1 Heart event (Pt. 2) The figure breaks into your house & sets up cameras when you're not there.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]The 3 heart event has the figure turning off the lights, turning you around, and brushing a non-explicitly said thing across your lips[/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]The 7 heart is the heaviest event (IMO); You get blindfolded, the figure's fingers touch your mouth really inappropriately while his hand and mouth touch your neck REALLY inappropriately. Also implies things might escalate if you were able to continue.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]The rewritten 10 heart event just has you momentarily getting blindfolded.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]In response to Seb & Alex's kissing events, this pack has Shadow events which cause you to get blindfolded and touched a lil.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/hxhBXTzw/faq-better.png[/img][/url]
[color=#ea9999][i][b]What portrait mod are you using in the mod photos? [/b][/i][/color]
I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16838]Rin's Portraits[/url]!

[i][b][color=#ea9999]Is this compatible with...?[/color][/b][/i]
For most dialogue mods it's an iffy thing. If you're placing in a dialogue mod for Sebastian, then yeah this one'll work fine. On the other hand, If you're ﻿placing in a mod for Sam, like some other Sam dialogue mods, then no. HOWEVER, in the config option there are options to turn off the dialogue/events if you prefer someone else's!

**A NOTE OR TWO ON COMPATIBILITY**
- i mean... hopefully he fuckin works with SVE... idk man we'll see
- the event lookup mod isn't fully updated to 1.6, so you might throw an error in the sense that it won't show up in the lookup menu, but you should still be able to trigger the event
- these mods are not made with poly in mind, nor will i be offering explicit poly compatibility. nonetheless, they will still work fine with poly mods. 

[color=#ea9999][b][i]Can I translate to...?﻿[/i]
[/b][/color]Yes! I give you my full permission to translate to whatever language you're wanting! One major change with this pack is it's setup for i18n! Making your ﻿lives much easier (hopefully). Just be sure to note me as the original author, please!


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/Rw6KfsD/requirements-better.png[/img][/url]
As well as [b]Content Patcher[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], you need the [b]Shadows After Dark mod[/b]!
Update 5.0.0 now requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url]


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/TxzNZh6p/config-menu-better.png[/img][/url]
[u][b][color=#e06666]PLAYER CONFIGURATION[/color][/b]
[/u][b]  ﻿Player Pronouns: 
[/b][color=#ea9999][b]  ﻿CAUTION - These are DIFFERENT compared to Alex's pack
[/b]  ﻿If you use She/Her pronouns, PAY ATTENTION to where you're putting things. I did not make an error here. [/color]
      ﻿﻿There are 2 slots for you to input your pronouns:
﻿  ﻿  ﻿﻿- Player Pronouns 1: [i]Would typically be something similar to "Them", "Her", "Him".
[/i]  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿- Player Pronouns 2: [i]Would typically be something similar to "Their", "Her", "His".
[/i][b]  ﻿Pet Name: 
[/b]      [i]﻿﻿Sets a desired name he refers to you as. I've been told users use things like "Angel", "Sunshine", "Babe", etc.
[/i][b]  ﻿Descriptive Word:
[/b]      [i]﻿﻿Would typically be "Pretty", "Cute", "Handsome", etc.
[/i][b]  ﻿Good...:
[/b]      [i]﻿﻿Erm, it's called a PRAISE KINK, tyvm. But, this is typically "Boy", "Girl", [s]"Slut"[/s]
[/i]  ﻿[b]Marriage Affection[/b]
[i]  ﻿  How Sam refers to you after marriage. Would typically be "Husband", "Wife", "Spouse", etc.[/i]

[color=#e06666][u][b]EVENTS/DIALOGUE/MAIL CONFIGURATION[/b][/u][/color]
﻿You are able to turn off/on events in general by toggling[b] "All Events, No Jealousy Events, No Events".[/b] 
﻿You are able to turn off/on dialogue by toggling the three options given:[b] "All Dialogue, No Jealousy Dialogue, No Dialogue"[/b]
You are able to turn off/no mail by toggling the three options given: [b]"Mail, No Mail"[/b]
[i]  ﻿Toggling this one off will **not** get rid of the mail needed for his events. You'll have to turn off events to get rid of that mail.[/i]


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/bRzngRJy/event-triggers-better.png[/img][/url]
The triggers & console commands for the rewritten vanilla events are the same as base game!

[b][color=#e06666][size=4]THE NEW EVENT TRIGGERS ARE AS FOLLOWS:[/size][/color]
[/b]
1 Heart Event: Enter town on a sunny day from 3pm to 5pm[/font]
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b][color=#ea9999]debug ebi SamADWetDream[/color][/b][/*]
[/list]
[font=Trebuchet MS]1 Heart Event, Pt 2: You must have seen the previous event first and must not be married to Sam. You must've also seen Seb's 1 heart event. Enter the farm from 8pm to 12am.[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b][color=#ea9999]debug ebi SamADBreakIn[/color][/b][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Trebuchet MS]3 Heart Event: You must've seen the 1 heart Event, Pt 2 first. Enter the bathhouse POOL from 5pm to 9pm.[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b][color=#ea9999]debug ebi SamADBathhouse[/color][/b][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS]
5 Heart Event: You must've seen the 3 heart event first. Enter the forest from 5pm to 8pm.[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b][color=#ea9999]debug ebi SamADTrippin[/color][/b][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Trebuchet MS]7 Heart Event: You must've seen the 3 heart event first. Enter Pierre's from 5pm to 8pm.[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b][color=#ea9999]debug ebi SamADChapel[/color][/b][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Trebuchet MS]9 Heart Event: You must've seen the 7 heart event first. Enter the forest from 8pm to 12am.[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b][color=#ea9999]debug ebi SamADFigureTease[/color][/b][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Trebuchet MS]
[color=#e06666][size=4][b]**NEW** JEALOUSY-RELATED EVENTS[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#e06666][u]When you're married to anyone but Sam:[/u][/color]
[i]*A small note: These events **should** maybe, hopefully work with polyamory mods. Maybe. They should (in theory) call a random spouse if you're married to multiple, just not Sam specifically.

[/i]Generic Beach Event: You must have at least 1 heart with Sam and not be married to him, have seen the 1 heart event, pt 2. You must be married to someone else. Enter the beach on a sunny day from 5pm to 9pm.[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b][color=#ea9999]debug ebi SamADGenericBeachJealousy[/color][/b] [/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Trebuchet MS]Generic Saloon Event: You must have at least 2 hearts with Sam and not be married to him and have seen the bathhouse event. You must be married to someone else. Enter the saloon from 8pm to 12am .[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b][color=#ea9999]debug ebi SamADGenericSaloonJealousy[/color][/b][/font][/*]
[/list]

[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#e06666][u]In response to Sebastian After Dark's Modpack:[/u][/color]

Post Fight Event: You must have seen Sebastian's 3 heart, Part 1 event BUT NOT the Part 2. Enter the beach after the fight from 8pm to 2am. If you trigger this event, you will be unable to get Seb's Part 2 event. [/font]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b][color=#ea9999]debug ebi SamADSamPostFight[/color][/b][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS]
Post Shotgun Kiss Event: You must have seen Sebastian's 5 heart event and chose the route to kiss him. Enter the backwoods afterwards from 8pm to 2am. [/font]

[list]
